name: codex-mobile-app
description: Control Codex on your Mac from your phone over your local network with a local-first PWA.
author: Asif Arshad

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @codex-mobile/server" "npm run dev --workspace @codex-mobile/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @codex-mobile/web && npm run build --workspace @codex-mobile/server
